defect: The fix only gates the new stdout dump of all multiscan ranges on an actual verification failure, because benign divergence (e.g. iter_start_ts with user timestamps) also sets diverged.
reason: Printing diagnostic lines to stdout on a benign divergence is log noise, not a wrong result, crash or build break; the crash test does not fail on stdout content and the fix keeps the added break.

defect: In ROCKSDB_LITE builds the private members sst_file_manager_, mutex_ and error_handler_ are never used, so clang's -Wunused-private-field with -Werror breaks the LITE build on macOS.
reason: The fix moves the members and the real body under #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE; the build break comes from the header this change added.

defect: The new assert(!prefetch_index || prefetch_filter) is inverted: it fires for a partitioned index without a partitioned filter, a valid configuration, while its own comment says filters require indexes.
reason: The fix flips the assert to !prefetch_filter || prefetch_index; the wrong assert was added by this change and contradicts the comment next to it.

defect: Passing the uint64 FLAGS_seed to the uint32_t seed parameter of FaultInjectionSecondaryCache is a narrowing conversion that MSVC treats as an error, breaking the Windows db_stress build.
reason: The fix adds an explicit conversion in the line this change added; seeing the problem needs the constructor signature and the flag's type from other files.

defect: The change puts #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE / #endif inside the argument list of the DEFINE_string(benchmarks, ...) macro, which is undefined in the preprocessor and fails to compile with MSVC.
reason: The fix replaces the directive with the IF_ROCKSDB_LITE macro already used a few lines above in the same string; the directive was added by this change.

defect: The fix renames the misspelled class ParititionedIndexIterator to PartitionedIndexIterator.
reason: Pure rename; the misspelled class already existed in partitioned_index_iterator.h before this change and the test compiled and ran correctly.

defect: The new RecordTick(stats_.get(), ...) calls read the shared_ptr stats_ without holding mu_, while SetStatisticsPtr (added by the same change in the header) writes it without synchronisation, a data race reported by TSAN.
reason: The fix takes mu_ around the RecordTick calls and in SetStatisticsPtr; both the unprotected reads and the setter come from this change, but the writer is in delete_scheduler.h.

defect: The fix moves SharedState out of RunStressTest because the stack-local SharedState is destroyed before the StressTest's DB, whose compaction filter still points to it (use after free).
reason: The stack-local SharedState line predates this change, which only added blank lines around it and the unverified-dir handling.

defect: In this header the fix only deletes the now unused IsInCurrentEarliestSnapshot/InCurrentEarliestSnapshot declarations and inline definition; the write-prepared SingleDelete bug it fixes is in compaction_iterator.cc.
reason: Removing dead code is a cleanup, and the faulty earliest_write_conflict_snapshot check in the .cc existed before this change.

defect: ASSERT_EQ compares int values (0, maxKey, 2 * maxKey) with the uint32_t GetCounter(), a signed/unsigned comparison that breaks the -Werror build on macOS.
reason: The fix makes the expected values unsigned; the comparisons were added by this change and GetCounter's uint32_t return type is in the same diff.

defect: The fix extends sst_dump --command=recompress with separate write and read timing, block size and thread output, and shorter labels.
reason: These are benchmark-tool improvements bundled with an LZ4 performance fix elsewhere; nothing this change wrote in the file is repaired as a defect.

defect: The fix uses a unique_ptr and an else branch so a ReplayerWorkerArg is not leaked for trace entry types other than write, get, seek and seek-for-prev.
reason: That leak for unhandled trace types already existed before this change, which only fixed the leak on a read error.

defect: The new forward declaration 'class SuperVersion;' conflicts with its definition as a struct in column_family.h, which clang rejects under -Werror,-Wmismatched-tags.
reason: The fix changes it to struct SuperVersion; the mismatch was added by this change but needs column_family.h to see.

defect: The fix moves table_properties_.reset(props) from PopulateIndex into Open, because full_scan_mode skips PopulateIndex and leaves table_properties_ null, crashing sst_dump.
reason: Setting table_properties_ only in PopulateIndex predates this refactor, which only reorganised the bloom allocation.

defect: The fix clears buf_ and the buffered checksum when the underlying Append fails, so a later Close or Flush does not write the same data twice.
reason: Keeping buf_ after a failed append was already the behaviour of WriteBuffered before this change; the new WriteBufferedWithChecksum only copied it.

defect: The fix replaces the in-loop ChangeOptions() skip in DBTest.Randomized with a skip mask and adds universal-compaction coverage to ChangeOptions.
reason: Test-infrastructure refactor; the ad-hoc skip did not cause a failure or wrong result.

defect: The fix changes the format for the unsigned stats_dump_period_sec (and other unsigned options) from %d to %u in Options::Dump.
reason: A %d/%u mismatch for an unsigned int logs correctly for all realistic values and broke no build; it is a format cleanup.

defect: The fix relaxes the AllocateTest preallocated-blocks check from ASSERT_EQ to ASSERT_LE because some filesystems allocate extra blocks.
reason: The exact block-count assertion predates this change, which only added casts to it.

defect: GetCreationTimeOfOldestFile calls cfd->current()->GetCreationTimeOfOldestFile without holding the DB mutex or referencing the Version, so a concurrent compaction can free it (heap use-after-free).
reason: The fix references a SuperVersion and skips dropped column families; the unprotected access is in the function this change added.

defect: The fix closes the #ifdef SNAPPY right after TestWithCompressedBlockCache and wraps tests moved in later under #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE.
reason: The LITE build failure came from tests moved into the file by a later commit (792762c Split db_test.cc), not from this change.

defect: The fix also counts range tombstones in num_entries and num_deletions for consistency.
reason: The promoted counters kept the semantics of the removed InternalKeyPropertiesCollector, which also ignored range deletions; the fix is a semantic change, not a repair.

defect: The fix removes the 2PC-only path that derives sequence numbers from the first recovered batch, which miscounts with missing logs or writes that skip the WAL.
reason: That counting logic existed before this change for all modes; this change only restricted it to allow_2pc.

defect: The lint fix makes ColumnFamilyHandle(uint32_t) explicit and adds an include and a namespace comment.
reason: Style change; the implicit constructor existed before this change, which only changed int to uint32_t.

defect: Replacing the leaked comparator singletons with namespace-scope static unique_ptrs destroys them during static destruction while other static objects or threads (e.g. in db_stress) still use them, causing a segfault.
reason: The fix returns function-local statics instead; the static-destruction hazard comes from the unique_ptrs this change introduced.

defect: On macOS the change enables the static A destructor, which at exit calls Instance()->pthread_key_ and OnThreadExit on the already destroyed StaticMeta (use after destruction), crashing db_stress.
reason: The fix disables this cleanup on macOS; the macOS path was added by this change, whose own comment says it relies on use-after-release.

defect: The new header includes "include/rocksdb/persistent_cache.h" instead of "rocksdb/persistent_cache.h", which does not resolve consistently in the internal build.
reason: The fix corrects the include path; the inconsistent path is in the header this change added and differs visibly from the codebase's include style.

defect: The fix spells out all OptionTypeInfo fields in every table entry so the header compiles with -Werror=missing-field-initializers.
reason: At this change OptionTypeInfo had only the three fields given, so the new entry was complete; the extra fields were added later.

defect: The new assert in MarkLogsSynced requires at most one remaining log, but SyncWAL releases the mutex before calling it, so a concurrent memtable switch can add logs and fire the assert.
reason: The fix weakens the assert to allow logs newer than up_to; the over-strict assert was added by this change, and the race needs the log-rolling code elsewhere.

defect: The fix changes the loop index in DontRollEmptyLogs from int to size_t to avoid a signed/unsigned comparison.
reason: At this change the Makefile used -Wno-sign-compare, so nothing broke; the fix belongs to the later commit that enabled the warning.

defect: The fix changes the loop index in FileIndexerTest::Reset from int to uint32_t to avoid a signed/unsigned comparison with kNumLevels.
reason: At this change the Makefile used -Wno-sign-compare, so nothing broke; the fix belongs to the later commit that enabled the warning.

defect: The new const int kWriteOutEveryBytes is compared with the size_t batch.GetDataSize(), a signed/unsigned comparison that fails the -Werror=sign-compare build.
reason: The fix makes the constant size_t; the comparison was added by this change, and the size_t return type of GetDataSize is in write_batch.h.

defect: A 200-byte stack buffer is passed to Summary(scratch, 256), allowing a stack buffer overflow that crashed compactions.
reason: The fix sizes the buffer to 256 and passes sizeof(scratch); the mismatch is in the two lines this change added.

defect: The new header forward-declares 'class Options;' although Options is a struct, which clang on macOS rejects under -Werror (mismatched tags).
reason: The fix uses struct Options; the declaration is in the header this change added, but the struct definition is in options.h.

defect: The fix maps all MANIFEST write errors to kManifestWriteNoWAL when the WAL sync succeeded, after a later change (#8049) separated WAL sync errors.
reason: The total_log_size_-based choice matched the error-handling design at this change; the fix commit attributes the bug to #8049.

defect: const int len = strlen(str) narrows size_t to int, which fails the macOS build with -Wshorten-64-to-32 and -Werror.
reason: The fix makes len a size_t; the narrowing assignment was added by this change.

defect: The new Windows mapping turns only ERROR_HANDLE_DISK_FULL into Status::NoSpace, so the usual disk-full error ERROR_DISK_FULL is still reported as a plain IOError.
reason: The fix adds ERROR_DISK_FULL to the condition this change introduced; the incomplete mapping gives the wrong status subcode on Windows.

defect: The new test ImmediateDeleteOn25PercDBSize asserts exactly 25 files in the trash directory, but the background thread may or may not have deleted the first trash file yet, so the test is flaky.
reason: The fix drops the timing-dependent assertion this change added; seeing the race needs DeleteScheduler's background deletion logic.

defect: The new static ReduceNumberOfLevels shrinks the version's files_ array to new_levels but, unlike the old member version, does not update the VersionSet's num_levels_, so WriteSnapshot in LogAndApply reads past the array and segfaults.
reason: The fix allocates the array with current_levels; the removed old implementation (another file) set num_levels_, so the defect came with this rewrite.

defect: In this file the fix only renames the member filter_data to filter_data_; the compile error of issue #284 (resetting a unique_ptr<const char[]> from char*) is in util/bloom.cc.
reason: The fix's edits here are a rename with no behaviour change; the defect it repairs does not lie in this file's lines.

defect: PrefixExtractorChanged now takes std::shared_ptr<const TableProperties> by value, adding an atomic refcount increment and decrement on every Get and NewIterator call, a performance regression.
reason: The fix passes a raw pointer; the by-value shared_ptr parameter was added by this change, and the fix commit names the resulting performance regression.
